# Whole roasted Meadow boar

Type: Feast | Internal ID: FeastMeadows_Material | Source: Food preparation table | Usage: Eating | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Cooked deer meat x2, Cooked boar meat x5, Dandelion x4, Woodland herb blend x1 | Max Health: 35 | Max Stamina: 35 | Duration: 50m | Healing: 2 hp/tick

# Introduction

Whole roasted Meadow boar is the Meadows-tier Feast.

## Recipe

Whole roasted Meadow boar can be produced at a Food preparation table with:
• Cooked deer meat x2
• Cooked boar meat x5
• Dandelion x4
• Woodland herb blend x1

## Trivia

• Although most of the ingredients are found in the Meadows, the Woodland herb blend is only sold by The Bog Witch in the Swamp after The Elder has been defeated, so the Whole roasted Meadow boar will generally be acquired by players who are already at the Swamps stage.

Categorias: Food, Feast
